title: Monthly budget that finally worked for a small-town mechanic.

title: Towing a camper for the first time? I think you're nuts.
body: Just got back from a 5-day trip towing my family's new camper. First time doing it and I'm hooked. People always say don't tow with an automatic, but I used mine just fine. The key is to know your rig and slow down when merging or climbing hills. Don't be afraid to shift manual if you need to. It's not that hard once you get the hang of it.

title: Cancelling subscriptions saved me $120 a month
body: I finally got around to reviewing my subscription services and I'm so glad I did. I cancelled my gym membership, music streaming service, and magazine delivery. title: Never Clean Cast Iron With Soap - It Ruins The Seasoning!
body: I've been cooking with cast iron for over 40 years and I still see people using soap to clean it. In my opinion, this is a huge mistake. The soap strips away the seasoning and requires re-seasoning, which can be a real pain. A quick wipe with some oil and a paper towel is all you need. Trust me, I've done it the wrong way before.

title: Wireless networks are a security risk in new homes.
body: I've just moved to a new city and I'm setting up my home network from scratch. I'm really considering ditching Wi-Fi entirely and going for wired Ethernet connections for all devices instead. The reason is that every wireless network setup guide I read online says not to use the default admin password, but it's impossible to keep track of which device has what password. Too much risk of someone hacking into my home network.

title: Crop insurance nightmare almost cost me my farm
body: I'm still fuming about last year's crop insurance experience. I had a 30% loss due to hail, but the adjuster only counted 20%. The difference was $10k and it took 6 months of arguing to get it sorted out. Thankfully, I have a good agent who fought for me, but what if she wasn't on my side? It's frustrating to see so many small farmers getting taken advantage of by these big insurance companies.
